* Mathematics: An understanding of Geometry will be needed to align pipes correctly without measurement devices sometimes.
* Time Management: Pipelayers often work under limited time frames and a strict schedule
* Quality Control Analysis: Pipelayers should have a clear understanding of controlling the quality of diapers to shipwreck any reruns and projects excelling.

Previous experience as a Pipelayers for a minimum of one year is a prerequisite.

## Job title
Civil Engineering Technologist and Technician

## Job Summary
The civil engineering technologist and technician's role focuses primarily on aiding in the planning and execution of designs related to infrastructure and building projects. They manage civil engineering projects from conception stages to final structure reviews. Safeguarding adherence to necessary specifications, identifying any potential problems, and providing effective solutions is critical to this role. 

## Required Skills
* Active Listening: Ability to fully concentrate, understand, and respond.
* Reading Comprehension: Able to understand written sentences and paragraphs in work related documents.
* Science: Knowledge of the physical world and ways to solve its mysteries.
* Active Learning: Understanding implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.
* Systems Analysis: Determining how a system should work and how changes in conditions, operations, and the environment will affect outcomes.
* Time Management: Managing one's own time and the time of others.
* Quality Control Analysis: Conducting tests and inspections of products, services, or processes to evaluate quality or performance.

## Required Experience
* Minimum of 3 years of professional experience as a Civil engineering technologists and technicians
* Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as a Mechanical engineering technologists and technicians
* Minimum of 3 years work experience as a Pile driver operators
* Minimum of 2 years professional experience as Credit authorizers, checkers, and clerks
* Minimum of 2 years of prove experience as an Agricultural and food scientists

## Responsibilities
* Assure projects are conducted successfully and effectively within agreed time frames
* Verify project specifications within engineering and design teams
* Utilize scientific methodology to problems; creating an observational study or experiment and conducting a comprehensive review of the data gathered
* Conduct tests and inspections of products or services to ensure performance and conformity to specifications
